To get the best out of your Chilly’s products, it’s less about pairing with extra gear and more about how you use them:

For colder drinks:
Fill bottles or cups with pre-chilled water from the fridge.
Top up with ice cubes.

How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

Sent · Just now

Chilly's Agent · AI

Chilly's Agent · AI says:

To get the best results from your Chilly’s, a few golden rules apply:

Before first use: Wash with hot soapy water, rinse well, and air‑dry with the cap/lid off.
Filling: Don’t use liquids over 90°C/194°F, and avoid organic drinks (like milk or juice) sitting in it overnight, as they can spoil and cause pressure.
For colder drinks: Use pre‑chilled water from the fridge and/or add ice cubes rather than relying on the fridge or freezer—because of the double‑wall vacuum, chilling in the fridge/freezer won’t really change the internal temperature.
Hot liquids (where allowed, e.g., bottles & coffee cups): Take care, as they can stay hot for hours. Don’t shake with hot liquids inside, and keep cups upright (many lids aren’t fully leak‑proof when hot).
Assembly: Make sure all pieces (collar, loop, retainers, straw, etc.) are fitted exactly as shown in the product’s instructions, and don’t over‑tighten the lid or collar.
Transport: Even where products or lids are very leak‑resistant, we generally recommend carrying them upright to avoid spills.
Cleaning:
Hand‑wash only; do not use a dishwasher, microwave, or freezer.
Clean after each use with hot soapy water; don’t leave the product to soak.
For deep cleans, use a paste of bicarbonate soda/baking powder + water + dish soap, leave it on marks for about 60 minutes, then scrub with a bottle brush.
Storage: When not using your bottle or cup, store it with the cap off so the inside can dry out.

Following these steps will help your Chilly’s stay fresher for longer, keep drinks at the right temperature, and avoid leaks or damage.
